headline: Russians banned from taking out more than ₽1 million in cash: list of countries and exceptions
summary: Russian President Vladimir Putin signed a decree restricting exports of cash rubles and refined gold by individuals to a number of countries. Individuals may not take out more than 1 million rubles in cash, with exceptions.
why: Capital and currency export controls affect household capital flows and the ruble's exposure to cross-border cash movements.
